Uses: -Treatment of hypertension. -To reduce the risk of stroke in patients with hypertension and left ventricular hypertrophy. -Treatment of diabetic nephropathy with an elevated serum creatinine and proteinuria (urinary albumin to creatinine ratio 300 mg/g or greater) in patients with type 2 diabetes and a history of hypertension.
